Test-ad scope finalization and project kickoff
Preview rejection, reference-led rebuild, and task termination

requirements.title: Conversion-Focused Ad Performance
requirements.definition: The video creative must be designed to improve conversions and work toward the client's target cost per lead rather than prioritize appearance alone.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the campaign-performance acceptance objective, including the stated sub-₹50 CPL target; hook construction, keywords, and editing techniques remain independently adjustable Requirements.

requirements.title: Landing Page and Tracking Audit
requirements.definition: Diagnose the click-to-landing-page loss and Quality Ranking concern and provide actionable landing-page or tracking recommendations.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested diagnostic deliverable, not generic testing of the video-ad Requirements.

requirements.title: Test Video Output Package
requirements.definition: Provide the commissioned test advertisement with the required quantity, duration, and aspect-ratio exports.
requirements.boundary_note: Quantity, approximately 30-second duration, and 9:16 and 4:5 exports are attributes of one delivery package; the two additional videos are conditional future work until separately ordered.

requirements.title: End-to-End Video Production
requirements.definition: The freelancer must handle the complete production workflow, including script, footage or generated scenes, voiceover, editing, and finished output rather than relying on client-supplied raw footage or voiceover.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers responsibility for producing all required source material; output dimensions and individual visual, audio, and messaging acceptance criteria remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Realistic AI-Generated UGC Visuals
requirements.definition: Use realistic, native-looking AI-generated video scenes resembling handheld UGC rather than avatars or animation derived from static images, without making the result appear obviously AI-generated.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the generation method and realism of the scenes; casting, lip sync, product placement, and pack-shot quality can fail or change independently.

requirements.title: Target Audience Alignment
requirements.definition: Tailor the advertisement's script and presentation to the Indian-market audience, particularly viewers aged 35 to 65 and older.
requirements.boundary_note: Audience targeting is separate from the demographics of the actors shown on screen and from the specific words used in the script.

requirements.title: Direct Viral Opening Hook
requirements.definition: Open with a strong, direct, non-generic hook suitable for Indian Meta users and capable of capturing attention within the first few seconds.
requirements.boundary_note: The opening hook has its own acceptance criterion and repeated failure trajectory; required keywords and broader campaign-performance goals remain separate.

requirements.title: Hindi-Only Script and Dialogue
requirements.definition: Deliver the advertisement's script, spoken dialogue, and preview dialogue in Hindi without English content.
requirements.boundary_note: Language is independently verifiable and can change without changing the selected claims, keywords, actors, or visual production method.

requirements.title: Product Keywords and Claims
requirements.definition: Use product-relevant benefits and high-performing Hindi pain-point terminology derived from the client's winner and reference videos while respecting explicitly prohibited wording.
requirements.boundary_note: Required terms, forbidden terms, benefit sources, and claim emphasis are attributes of one message-content mechanism; hook strength and language choice are independently testable.

requirements.title: Reference-Aligned Creative Direction
requirements.definition: Use the client's successful reference material to guide the ad's message and structure while following the currently confirmed degree of originality or recreation.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns the evolving relationship to the references, from an original non-copy concept to an improved recreation; individual keywords and hook quality remain separate.

requirements.title: Testimonial-Style Creative Format
requirements.definition: Present the advertisement through believable testimonial or interpersonal scenarios rather than a generic product-only presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Narrative format can be modified independently of reference similarity, actor demographics, and the exact product claims.

requirements.title: Indian Actor Casting
requirements.definition: Feature only Indian actors in the advertisement, with male actors preferred.
requirements.boundary_note: On-screen actor identity is independently adjustable from the target audience, scene-generation method, and testimonial narrative.

requirements.title: Accurate Dialogue Lip Sync
requirements.definition: Provide precise, natural-looking lip synchronization and facial performance wherever actors speak.
requirements.boundary_note: Lip-sync correctness has a distinct observable success criterion and is not merely an attribute of actor casting or general visual realism.

requirements.title: Retention-Focused Editing and Cuts
requirements.definition: Use suitably timed, quick scene cuts and transitions that maintain attention and support short-form Meta retention.
requirements.boundary_note: Cut timing and pacing can be assessed and corrected independently of audio levels, hook wording, and scene realism.

requirements.title: Professional Advertising Audio Mix
requirements.definition: Provide appropriately loud, balanced advertising audio with suitable voice levels, background music, and sound effects.
requirements.boundary_note: Audio loudness, balance, music, and effects form one audio-mixing mechanism; the exact meaning of the requested 'Audio DB 25' value needs verification.

requirements.title: Mobile-Optimized Subtitles
requirements.definition: Include professionally produced subtitles formatted for viewing in a short-form mobile advertisement.
requirements.boundary_note: Subtitle rendering is independently testable from spoken-language choice, audio mixing, and the underlying script.

requirements.title: Organic Call to Action
requirements.definition: Include a clear call to action that is incorporated naturally into the advertisement.
requirements.boundary_note: The closing action request is independently assessable from product claims, opening-hook quality, and visual finishing.

requirements.title: UGC Color Grading and Finish
requirements.definition: Apply color correction and final visual finishing that preserves a polished but organic Facebook and Instagram UGC appearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Final color and finish can be corrected independently of scene realism, actor casting, and editing pace.

requirements.title: Short Preview Before Full Production
requirements.definition: Provide a short Hindi preview containing representative visuals and dialogue for client evaluation before completing the full advertisement.
requirements.boundary_note: The preview is a separately requested executable artifact and approval checkpoint, not generic testing activity; its requested duration is an attribute.

requirements.title: Placement of Both Products
requirements.definition: Show both of the client's products in the advertisement, including a closing or combined presentation where appropriate.
requirements.boundary_note: Whether both products appear is independently testable from the quality of the second product's generated pack shot and from optional diabetes messaging.

requirements.title: AI-Improved Second Product Pack Shot
requirements.definition: Generate an improved visual representation of the second product with AI because a suitable source image is unavailable.
requirements.boundary_note: Pack-shot generation has its own asset-quality criterion and remains separate from the requirement that both products appear.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client initially requested 'actual footage,' while the freelancer explicitly offered realistic AI-generated scenes rather than live-action filming. Subsequent contracting and feedback suggest AI scenes were accepted, but the exact acceptance transition should be verified during Event extraction.
The audio-mixing Requirement is clear, but the client's phrase 'Audio DB 25' is technically ambiguous and should not be normalized to a specific loudness standard without further evidence.
